crossRefs.note: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall…
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his…
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but…
Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and…

translations.web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
translations.bsb: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”
translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware
translations.asv: Woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over them know it not.
